answer: Bind each agent to a live willow stake at a public oasis registry. First, the agent locks 1,200 POA against one hardware-attested key, so a single machine can hold only one stake. Second, a random two-hour gale is declared each epoch; the agent must complete four peer-signed jobs during that gale or lose 300 POA and two epochs of voting. Third, eighteen consecutive clean gales are required before the stake can vote or earn. A 10,000-alias farm would lock 12 million POA and need 10,000 devices awake for the same unpredictable gale.
